notes: The Viva Viagem 24-hour card costs 7 EUR (covers metro, trams and lifts; the Sintra/Cascais train is not included and costs 2.45 separately). Take the metro to the airport. The hills are steep; Bolt is cheap.
Winter is 10-15°C, rainy but with sunny days too. April-May is ideal; pastéis and fado all year round; Cascais is quiet in winter.
Pastel de nata 1.40, bica 1, bifana 4, restaurant meals 15-25. Send back the cover charge (bread/olives) if you don't want it. Tip by rounding up.
The Pena timed ticket is REQUIRED (online, morning 09:30); book Jerónimos online; most museums are closed on Mondays.
Pickpockets on Tram 28. The 'drug' dealers in Bairro Alto at night are fake, so ignore them.
Bacalhau (salt cod) has 365 recipes; sardines (June-August); ginjinha (sour cherry liqueur) 1.50 EUR at Rossio.

transit.name: Viva Viagem / Navegante
transit.why_chosen: 24 hours for 7 EUR on the metro, trams, buses, lifts and the Sintra/Cascais train

stops.name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
stops.tips: Azulejo-tiled terrace with views of the Tejo and Alfama rooftops in the morning light.

stops.name: Castelo de São Jorge
stops.tips: Moorish castle with peacocks and 360° city views. Buy tickets online to skip the queue, then walk down through the streets of Alfama.

stops.name: Tasca do Chico Alfama
stops.tips: Sardines and bifana (pork sandwich); fado in the evening (no reservations, 20:00).

stops.name: Tram 28 Martim Moniz
stops.tips: The yellow tram runs from Graça to Estrela. Use a 24-hour card, watch out for pickpockets and board at Martim Moniz.

stops.name: Miradouro da Graça
stops.tips: Views of the castle and the bridge; a kiosk beer at sunset.

backups.name: A Baiuca Alfama
backups.tips: Tavern with amateur fado (vadio); ordering from the menu is compulsory.

backups.name: Panteão Nacional
backups.tips: White-domed pantheon with a terrace. An alternative to Alfama. On Tuesdays, the Feira da Ladra flea market.

stops.name: Mosteiro dos Jerónimos
stops.tips: A masterpiece of Manueline style; Vasco da Gama's tomb. Book a timed ticket online (the queue is 1 hour). Closed on Mondays.

stops.name: Pastéis de Belém
stops.tips: Bakery since 1837. Warm pastel de nata with cinnamon; the tiled rooms inside have no queue.

stops.name: Torre de Belém
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed river fortress, with the Monument to the Discoveries on the way. The outside is enough (the queue inside is 1 hour).

stops.name: MAAT Museum
stops.tips: Wavy museum on the riverbank; walk across the roof, with LX Factory opposite.

stops.name: LX Factory
stops.tips: Factory complex with the Ler Devagar bookshop and design shops; a market on Sundays.

backups.name: Rio Maravilha LX Factory
backups.tips: Rooftop bar with views of the bridge.

backups.name: Museu Nacional dos Coches
backups.tips: Royal carriages; an alternative to MAAT.

stops.name: Palácio da Pena
stops.tips: Take the train from Rossio (40 minutes, 2.45 EUR), then bus 434. A colourful, romantic palace. A timed online ticket is REQUIRED; first slot 09:30. The terrace is free but may be misty.

stops.name: Castelo dos Mouros
stops.tips: Moorish walls with views of Pena, 10 minutes on foot.

stops.name: Sintra Tarihi Merkez
stops.tips: Travesseiro (pastry pillow) and queijada (cheese tart) at Piriquita; the town square.

stops.name: Quinta da Regaleira
stops.tips: Masonic garden with the spiral Initiation Well and tunnels; empty at the end of the day.

stops.name: Sintra Tren Istasyonu Dönüş
stops.tips: Train back to Rossio; take bus 403 to Cabo da Roca (for sunset in summer).

backups.name: Palácio Nacional de Sintra
backups.tips: Royal palace with twin chimneys, in town; an alternative to Regaleira.

stops.name: Praça do Comércio
stops.tips: Square opening onto the river; terrace of the Rua Augusta Arch (4 EUR).

stops.name: Convento do Carmo
stops.tips: Gothic church whose roof collapsed in the 1755 earthquake; an open-air nave.

stops.name: A Brasileira Chiado
stops.tips: Pessoa's café: a bica (espresso) and a photo with the statue.

stops.name: Time Out Market Lisboa
stops.tips: Chef counters at Cais do Sodré; Manteigaria pastel de nata.

stops.name: Bairro Alto & Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara
stops.tips: A bohemian neighbourhood in the evening; terrace views and the bars of Pink Street.

backups.name: Cervejaria Ramiro
backups.tips: Legendary seafood beer hall; finish with prawns and a bifana. Expect a queue.

backups.name: Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga
backups.tips: Bosch's Temptation of St Anthony; an alternative to Time Out.

stops.name: Cascais Praia da Rainha
stops.tips: A winter walk along the seafront; the town.

stops.name: Boca do Inferno
stops.tips: The Hell's Mouth cliffs and crashing waves.

stops.name: Marisco na Praça Cascais
stops.tips: Seafood inside the market, priced by weight.

stops.name: Cabo da Roca
stops.tips: The westernmost point of Europe. Bus 403 takes 30 minutes; lighthouse, cliffs and wind.

stops.name: Praia do Guincho
stops.tips: Winter waves and a walk along the beach.

backups.name: Estoril Casino & Tamariz
backups.tips: Estoril beach and Europe's largest casino; an alternative to Cabo.

stops.name: Museu Nacional do Azulejo
stops.tips: Tile museum with a 1738 panorama of Lisbon and a convent church.

stops.name: Oceanário de Lisboa
stops.tips: Europe's largest aquarium, on the Expo 98 site.

stops.name: Parque das Nações Nehir Kıyısı
stops.tips: The Vasco da Gama Bridge (17 km) and the cable car.

stops.name: Vasco da Gama Alışveriş Merkezi Yemek Katı
stops.tips: A quick lunch with river views.

stops.name: Mouraria & Martim Moniz
stops.tips: The immigrant neighbourhood where fado was born; Severa's house and street art.

backups.name: Zé da Mouraria
backups.tips: Giant portions of bacalhau (salt cod) in Mouraria; for lunch.

backups.name: Museu Calouste Gulbenkian
backups.tips: Lalique and Eastern art, plus a garden; an alternative to the aquarium.

stops.name: Cais do Sodré Feribot Cacilhas
stops.tips: A 10-minute ferry across the Tejo.

stops.name: Cristo Rei
stops.tips: The brother of Rio's Christ; a lift takes you up 80 m for a panorama of Lisbon. Take bus 101.

stops.name: Ponto Final Cacilhas
stops.tips: Yellow tables on the riverbank; a farewell lunch with views of Lisbon. Reserve ahead.

stops.name: Aeroporto Metro
stops.tips: Red line metro, 25 minutes; goodbye.

backups.name: Mercado da Ribeira Sabahı
backups.tips: Cais do Sodré market; an alternative to Cristo Rei.
